usedFor: Callbell is the shared inbox for customers and HubSpot holds the contact record, so “Contact Updated” can keep it current through “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Updated” in Callbell, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Changes made in the inbox reach HubSpot, so sales sees the same contact details as support.

watchOut: “Update Contact” finds the HubSpot contact by its email, so “Contact Updated” needs to pass an email that already exists there.
